name: 84106 · Salt Lake Cty, UT
findings: ZIP 84106 (Salt Lake Cty) has 141 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84106 (Salt Lake Cty) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84106 (Salt Lake Cty) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 84106 (Salt Lake Cty) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?
